screen_decision.protocol: Both small-program screen medians >=15% lower trigger quality and independent confirmation; this is not the substantial-win acceptance itself.

baseline_profile.protocol: Diagnostic only: ordinary-depth private user cache, single Windows target, unchanged fixed post-queue producer, first visits separate from warm profiles. Exact images and actual native exits; phase attribution is not an A/B speedup.

decision: Not promoted: screen missed its predeclared two-subject 15 percent gate (length 27.5 percent, dispatch 12.0 percent, stack32 13.6 percent). Mixed current-host wall evidence does not establish a repeatable substantial win. All 60 compile/image/native observations retained; expanded quality and confirmation deliberately not run. Park the unpublished mechanism and restore only its four Rust files before the next experiment.
